Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} (revenant family)

Patron Clan: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}

Once librarians and clerics in the northern Byzantine Empire, the Obertuses survive on knowledge rather than wealth or force, keeping contact with the wider @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} to a handful of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} scholars. After centuries in the Tzimisce strongholds of eastern Europe, the family spread with Spanish and Portuguese colonization; today most live in New England and eastern Canada, with smaller enclaves in Brazil and eastern Europe, generally in small towns far from commerce and distraction.

Role: Occult and esoteric researchers — the Sabbat's archivists and investigators of hidden forces. Individual enclaves often specialize for generations in a single field of study, from poltergeists to suburban cryptozoology, in service to what the Tzimisce regard as valuable basic research.

The family elders pursue a secret, independent project: a belief that revenants — and Obertuses above all — represent a new species destined to replace humanity, and that the family must find a way to make the revenant transformation happen naturally, without vampiric participation. In pursuit of this goal they covertly study and experiment on variations of the Embrace and ghouling, occasionally capturing @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} or independent Kindred (and even arranging the disappearance of stray Sabbat vampires) for observation, with results so far mostly cataloguing failure.

Disciplines: Auspex, Obfuscate, Vicissitude

Weakness: Bred for intellect without regard to stability, every Obertus carries at least one derangement of an intellectual nature, most commonly @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.derangements.JournalEntry.d2018925d46840e1]{Obsessive/Compulsive} Derangement (others possible with Storyteller approval).
